package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

// An untyped constant compared directly with a dependency call's result
// takes the result's type, as Go converts it: float64 8 == 8, not int 8.

func main() {
	if math.Pow(2, 3) != 8 {
		fmt.Println("pow != 8")
	}
	fmt.Println(math.Pow(2, 3) == 8, 8 == math.Pow(2, 3), math.Sqrt(2) == 1.4142135623730951)
	fmt.Println(strings.Count("banana", "a") == 3, strings.ToUpper("x") == "X", math.Signbit(-1) == true)
	// Positive control: the same comparisons through a variable, which
	// already carried the result's type.
	p := math.Pow(2, 3)
	n := strings.Count("banana", "a")
	fmt.Println(p == 8, p != 8, n == 3, n != 3)
	if math.Floor(2.5) == 2 {
		os.Exit(3)
	}
}
